events.what: Rubin improves bounds for point selections and halving hyperplanes in dimensions d>=3 (notably d>=5)
Alonso, López and Rodrigo improve the additive constant in the asymptotic upper bound on planar halving lines (even n), and the upper bound for specific n in [106,336]
Explicit point configurations raising the lower bound on the maximum number of halving lines for n=35, 59, 95, 97

judgement.doubts: Rubin's result had a preliminary version at SODA 2024 (held in January 2024, before the snapshot per the record's own statement), so the March 2024 arXiv posting is not a new event (F7); it is also a higher-dimensional analogue that may be a variant. Status rests on the Symmetry paper's improved constant in the asymptotic halving-line upper bound, a modest bound movement; one could argue a constant-term improvement barely moves the question, but it does move the quantity. The odd-n lower-bound constructions are finitely many values, treated as instances.

outcome_prefix: Status rests on Alonso, López and Rodrigo (Symmetry, 22 July 2024), which improves the additive constant in the asymptotic upper bound on planar halving lines; Rubin's halving-hyperplane result first appeared at SODA 2024, before the snapshot.

corrections.why: F14: the record says none of the results 'settled a full case'; a progress row carries direction null.

F7: the summary says Rubin's paper had a 'preliminary version at SODA 2024', a January 2024 conference before the snapshot, so the arXiv posting is a re-dating; the earliest post-snapshot bound movement is the Symmetry paper.
